title: 90-Second Minesweeper
description: Clear the minefield before the 90-second timer runs out. Play this fast-paced classic puzzle game for free in your browser.
about:
90-Second Minesweeper is a browser game where you reveal safe squares and use the clues to locate the mines before the timer runs out. Flag suspected mines.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Reveal safe squares and use the clues to locate the mines before the timer runs out. Flag suspected mines.
tips: Use click / tap to reveal a square.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.
